l0_intro: Before we start designing, watch this short video to see what you can do with Canva on your phone.
l0_takeaways_list: Canva has thousands of free templates | You can change text and colors in seconds | It works perfectly on your phone
l1_title: Welcome to Canva on Your Phone
l1_intro_body: Design from your pocket. Today is your first tiny step to making posts for yourself or small businesses. You don't need a degree, just your phone.
l1_goal_body: 1. Open Canva and sign in. | 2. Pick the right size for a post. | 3. Type your first line of text.
l1_checklist_body: Open the Canva app | Sign in or create a free account | Tap 'Create design' → 'Instagram Post' (Square) | Tap 'Text' → 'Add heading' | Type: '[Your Name] · Dreamer'
l1_task_body: Create a simple post with your Name + One Word that describes you. Use any background color you love. Save it to your phone!
l2_intro_body: No big theories. Just 3 secrets professionals use daily to make things look good.
l2_r1_body: Light text on dark background. Or dark text on light. Never 'light on light' or 'dark on dark'.
l2_r2_body: Line things up. Either Center everything OR Left Align everything. Don't mix them randomly.
l2_r3_body: Empty space is not 'wasted'. It makes your main message louder. Move things away from the edges.
l2_checklist_body: Fix colors for better contrast | Choose one alignment (center/left) | Move elements away from edges
l2_task_body: Make 1 post with a short quote (e.g. 'Small steps. Big dreams.'). Apply the 3 rules: Strong contrast, neat alignment, and space.
l3_title: Templates That Do the Hard Work
l3_intro_body: Designers don't start from zero. You don't have to either. Templates save time and teach you good layouts.
l3_step1_body: Open Canva. Tap 'Templates'. Search for 'sale', 'motivation', or 'small business'.
l3_checklist_body: Change ALL text to your own words | Change at least one color | Replace the photo with yours or a free one
l3_task_body: Choose a template for a shop, a club, or a cause. Customize the text, color, and image so it looks unique.
l4_intro_body: Stuck on layout? Let AI suggest designs for you. You describe the idea, AI shows ready-made posts.
l4_prompts_body: 'Bakery sale this weekend' | 'Motivational quote for girls' | 'Free health camp invitation'
l4_checklist_body: Open Magic Design / AI Design | Choose Instagram Post | Paste your prompt | Pick a layout | Change brand name, colors, and fonts
l4_task_body: Use AI to design a post for homemade snacks/food. Customise the text, color, and contact info.
l5_title: Magic Write: Captions & Hooks with AI
l5_intro_body: Words feel hard? Let AI suggest, you polish. AI gives ideas, you edit the voice, you make the final call.
l5_styles_body: 1. Hook + Info + Action | 2. Problem + Promise | 3. Tiny Story
l5_checklist_body: Generate a caption with Magic Write | Replace hard words with simple ones | Add one local detail or emoji
l5_task_body: Pick one of your designs. Create 2 AI captions. Edit them into 1 final caption that sounds like YOU.
l6_intro_body: No fancy camera needed. AI and simple edits are enough. You have two options: Clean a real photo OR Generate an AI illustration.
l6_checklist_body: Take photo of an item | Upload to Canva | Remove background (if possible) | Pick a simple background color
l6_checklist2_body: Open AI Image tool | Paste a prompt (e.g. 'girl designing on phone') | Choose 'Flat' or 'Illustration' style | Insert into design
l6_task_body: Create a post with your item. Show the messy 'before' and the clean 'after' design.
l7_intro_body: Today we combine layout, image, and caption into one full post. Choose a topic: Small Business, School Club, or Social Cause.
l7_checklist_body: Use Magic Design for layout | Add real or AI image | Apply contrast & alignment | Use Magic Write for caption | Add Date/Offer/Action
l7_task_body: Create one full post for your chosen topic. Make it good enough to share in a WhatsApp group.
l8_intro_body: Share everywhere smartly. One idea can be a Square Post (Feed) or a Tall Post (Story/Status).
l8_sizes_body: Square = Feed post. Tall = Story/Status. Both can show the same idea.
l8_checklist_body: Copy your campaign post | Change to tall size | Enlarge main text | Remove extra small text | Add clear CTA (e.g., 'DM Us')
l8_task_body: Create 2 versions of your campaign: 1 Feed Post + 1 Story/Status.
l9_intro_body: You're ready to think like a social media manager. A designer plans a few connected posts that work together.
l9_plan_body: Post 1: Story / Motivation | Post 2: Product / Result | Post 3: Offer / Reminder
l9_checklist_body: Create Post 1 (Story) | Create Post 2 (Result) | Create Post 3 (Offer + Action) | Use Canva + at least 1 AI tool for each
l9_task_body: Complete your 3 posts. Ensure they use the same colors/fonts. Submit them for your final badge!

wa_l3_steps: Go to Business Tools > Business Profile | Tap 'Schedule' | Select 'Open for selected hours' | Set your shop timings
wa_l4_intro: The Catalog is your digital menu. No need to send 50 photos to every customer.
wa_l4_steps: Go to Business Tools > Catalog | Tap 'Add new item' | Upload 1-3 good photos | Add Name, Price, and Description
wa_q4_q: Where do customers see your products?
wa_l5_intro: Send your entire shop to a customer in one click.
wa_l5_steps: Open your Catalog | Tap the Link icon (top right) | Copy Link or 'Send via WhatsApp' | Send to a friend to test
wa_l6_intro: Be polite automatically. Welcome new customers instantly.
wa_l6_steps: Tools > Greeting Message | Turn on 'Send greeting' | Write: 'Namaste! Welcome to [Shop Name]. How can we help?'
wa_q6_q: When is a greeting message sent?
wa_q6_b: To new customers or after 14 days inactivity
wa_l7_intro: Stop typing 'My UPI number is...' 10 times a day.
wa_l7_steps: Tools > Quick Replies | Tap + | Shortcut: /pay | Message: 'Here is our UPI ID: abc@upi. Thank you!' | Save
wa_l8_intro: Who paid? Who is new? Use colored tags to remember.
wa_l8_steps: Long press a chat | Tap 'Labels' tag icon | Select 'New Order' or 'Payment Pending' | See all labels in Menu later
wa_l9_intro: You are ready! Let's check everything one last time.
wa_l9_steps: Check profile photo | Check catalog has 1+ item | Check greeting message is on | You are ready to launch!
assignment_wa_desc: Setup your real or practice WhatsApp Business profile. Upload 3 screenshots: 1. Your Profile (showing logo & info), 2. A Catalog item, 3. Your Auto-Greeting message setup.
assignment_wa_crit1_desc: Does profile have photo, name, and description?
assignment_wa_crit2_desc: Is product photo clear and price visible?
assignment_wa_crit3_desc: Is the greeting message polite and helpful?
cc_l0_intro: Short videos are the best way to grow today. See what you can create from your phone.
cc_l0_takeaways: CapCut is free and powerful | Music makes or breaks your video | Transitions keep people watching
cc_l1_intro: Let's open the studio in your pocket.
cc_l1_steps: Download CapCut | Open and tap 'New Project' | Select a video from your gallery | Understand the 'Timeline' (bottom bar)
cc_q1_q: The area where you edit clips is called...
cc_l2_intro: Cut the boring parts. Keep it fast!
cc_l2_steps: Tap the video strip | Move the white line to where you want to cut | Tap 'Split' | Delete the bad part
cc_q2_q: If a video is too long, you should...
cc_l3_steps: Tap 'Audio' > 'Sounds' | Pick a trending song | Drag it to match the start of your video
cc_l4_intro: Many watch without sound. Text is mandatory.
cc_l4_steps: Tap 'Text' | 'Auto Captions' > Start | Watch AI write your words | Correct any spelling mistakes
cc_l5_intro: Move from one clip to another smoothly.
cc_l5_steps: Find the white box between two clips | Tap it | Choose 'Pull In' or 'Blink' | Keep duration short (0.5s)
cc_l6_intro: Fast for boring parts, slow for cool parts.
cc_l6_steps: Tap a clip | Tap 'Speed' | 'Normal' > 2x (Fast) or 0.5x (Slow Mo)
cc_q6_q: To show a long process quickly, use...
cc_l7_steps: Tap 'Effects' > 'Video Effects' | Try 'Diamond Zoom' or 'Sparkle' | Tap 'Adjust' to fix brightness
cc_l8_intro: A great video needs a hook.
cc_l8_steps: Start with action or a question | Don't say 'Hello friends' for 5 seconds | Get straight to the point
cc_q8_b: The first 3 seconds that grab attention
cc_l9_steps: Check your captions | Ensure music ends with video | Tap '1080p' top right | Export!
assignment_cc_desc: Edit a 15-second reel. It can be a product showcase, a 'day in life', or a tip. Must use: 1. Cuts, 2. Text/Captions, 3. Music. Upload screenshots of your timeline.
assignment_cc_crit1_desc: Are there cuts to keep it interesting?
assignment_cc_crit2_desc: Is there text explaining the video?
assignment_cc_crit3_desc: Does it have music and a clear ending?
gbp_l0_intro: Why do customers trust shops on Google Maps? Watch this.
gbp_l0_takeaways: Customers search 'near me' every day | It is free advertising | Reviews build trust instantly
gbp_l1_steps: Search your shop name on Google Maps | If it appears, tap 'Claim this business' | If not, search 'Google Business Profile' > 'Manage Now'
gbp_q1_q: If your shop is already on Maps...
gbp_q1_b: Claim it to control the info
gbp_l2_intro: Be specific so Google knows who to show you to.
gbp_l2_steps: Use the exact shop name (e.g. 'Riya Beauty Parlour') | Choose the correct category (e.g. 'Beauty Salon' not just 'Store')
gbp_l3_steps: Enter address | Drag the red pin on the map to your shop's door | Add service areas if you deliver
gbp_q3_b: So customers find the exact door
gbp_l4_intro: Google needs to know you are real.
gbp_l4_steps: Choose verification method (Video call, Phone code, or Postcard) | Follow instructions exactly | Wait for the code
gbp_l5_steps: Add Logo | Add Cover Photo (Outside view) | Add 3-5 Interior photos | Add Team photos
gbp_l6_steps: Ask happy customers: 'Can you give us a 5-star rating?' | Share your review link via WhatsApp | Reply to every review
gbp_q6_q: If you get a bad review...
gbp_q6_a: Reply politely and offer to fix it
gbp_l7_steps: Use 'Add Update' | Post about new stock, festivals, or discounts | Add a photo to every update
gbp_l8_steps: Turn on 'Messaging' | Add FAQs in the Q&A section (e.g. 'Do you have parking?', 'Yes')
gbp_l9_steps: Check Name, Hours, Phone | Ensure photos look good | Send link to a friend to test
assignment_gbp_desc: Setup or update a Google Business Profile. Upload 3 screenshots: 1. Profile Home (showing name/verified), 2. 'Info' tab with hours, 3. A review or update posted.
assignment_gbp_crit1_desc: Is the business visible or in verification?
